prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png, using design_reference.png as approved material/detail reference and icon_x8.png as colour reference (magenta is background, never paint magenta).
Output ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 canvas. Exact guide layout: THREE columns and FOUR rows of equal square cells. Row 1 FRONT, BACK, LEFT; row 2 RIGHT, TOP, EMPTY; row 3 FRONT, BACK, LEFT; row 4 RIGHT, TOP, EMPTY. Preserve every guide object's exact position, size, outline, gaps and openings. Paint grey objects only, never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign. Empty cells remain entirely transparent.
Object: A plain glass jar that could hold any liquid with great efficiency. Follow the approved reference's smoky dark grey glass jar, aged brass/gold lid and neck bands, and small muted greenish skull detail visible at front. Adapt details correctly to orthographic views. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour only, detailed surface colour without lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights or reflections. No glow halo, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: fill the identical five silhouettes with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. Pure red #FF0000 every metal part including brass lid/neck bands. Pure green #00FF00 leather/fur only. Pure blue #0000FF cloth/hair only. Pure yellow #FFFF00 matte nonmetal solid (wood/bone/horn/stone/parchment/paper/wax) only. Pure black #000000 every gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid seen through glass. Thus jar glass bodies are solid opaque pure black and metal lids/bands pure red; top view metal cap pure red. Every pixel inside each silhouette must have exactly one specified material colour. Nothing outside silhouettes. Background fully transparent, including both empty cells. Preserve same guide silhouettes across both halves.
CORRECTION: The prior attempt used an overly narrow canvas and widened/repositioned jars. Match the FIRST attached guide exactly. Canvas MUST be 1536 wide x 2048 high (3:4), NOT 1:2. Preserve guide alpha silhouettes and exact margins. Each upright jar fits approximately x=129..383 in its 512px cell, y=33..479, NOT filling the cell width. Centers x=256,768,1280. Row origins y=0,512,1024,1536. Top view center (768,768), duplicated at (768,1792). No black line strokes on the red material regions, flat solid red throughout metal. Glass including skull seen through glass is flat black in masks. Do not create any yellow skull patch in mask.
